svg.text: Fast RL with Quantized Rollouts - Plug-in Patcher for vLLM + VeRL Training Loop
Token-level IS ratio corrects rollout/train mismatch
PPO / GRPO / DAPO control loop unchanged
Compare bf16 vs w8a8/fp8 to derive online quant params
Not needed for native fp8 or bf16 logprob-only path
llm-compressor w8a8 + RedHatAI HF quantized models
flashrl setup -a --fn bf16: append hybrid DP config
Mixed bf16/int8 rollout across DP worker ratio
Auto-inject on pip install - or manual import flash_rl
Reads FLASHRL_CONFIG: bf16 | fp8 | yaml path | HF profile
Patches vLLM: online quant weight load + accurate logprob
Layer-by-layer weight sync from FSDP policy to vLLM
Setup flow: profile (int8) - setup yaml - export FLASHRL_CONFIG - pip install patches vLLM at import
Quantized Rollout RL Loop (per training step)
Policy trains in BF16 FSDP - rollout runs in INT8/FP8 patched vLLM
Step 1: Actor (FSDP BF16) holds policy weights - ready for grad update
Step 2: Layer-by-layer weight sync - bf16 weights sent to vLLM inference engine
Step 3: Patcher online-quantizes weights (INT8/FP8) using profile/config yaml
Step 4: Quantized rollout generation - accurate rollout logprob returned
Step 5: Reward + advantage - TIS token correction on policy loss - update actor
bf16 mode: logprob-only patch (no quant rollout) - for TIS without throughput gain
Best for 14B+ models with long CoT (DAPO) - quant overhead not worth it on small GSM8K runs
Train (FSDP) and rollout (vLLM) use different libs - distribution mismatch is inherent
pi_rollout(a|s) != pi_train(a|s) due to engine/precision mismatch
Apply token-level IS ratio clip to policy gradient loss
Hybrid DP: N/M workers bf16 rollout, rest int8
flashrl setup -a --fn bf16 reduces rollout-grad gap
DAPO 32B: INT8 rollout matches BF16 AIME accuracy with higher updates/hour throughput
Multi-node: set FLASHRL_CONFIG in verl/trainer/runtime_env.yaml for Ray submit jobs
NVIDIA CUDA 12.6 - hiyouga/verl NGC images - vLLM 0.8.3-0.10.0 - Ray 2.43-2.48 - flash-llm-rl 1.0.1+
Init path: pip install flash-llm-rl - optional profile/setup - export FLASHRL_CONFIG - launch VeRL recipe script
Step path: sync bf16 weights - online quant - quantized rollout - TIS-corrected loss - actor update - repeat
Sources: yaof20/Flash-RL README - yaof20/verl recipe/flash_rl - SkyRL docs flash_rl - fengyao.notion.site/flash-rl
